correctness.rationale: Coordinate supports attain 0 and cap w_ij. For each oriented triangle functional F=d_ij-d_ik-d_jk, exact min -2 min(w_ik,w_jk) follows from a truncated 1-Lipschitz ultrametric distance-to-{i,j} function and its cut semimetric; max F=0. Reflection feasibility for z=(s+1)c gives z_ij<=s w_ij and z_ik+z_jk-z_ij>=2min(w_ik,w_jk). In any ultrametric triple its shortest pair forces s>=2; z=2w attains 2. At s=2, cap deficits vanish in equilateral triples, have zero short-edge deficit and equal long deficits in isosceles triples. Root-block triangles force all internal deficits zero, all cross deficits zero with three or more blocks, and a common h in two blocks restricted by R-L. Independent LP of n=3 ultrametric (1,5,5) found s=2, center coordinate intervals [2/3,2/3],[2,10/3],[2,10/3].
